required_resolution: Re-establish authoritative evidence and provenance before any material fact update.
policy: Do not automatically change deadline, eligibility, budget, scoring, beneficiaries, call status, or any other material fact. Resolve only from authoritative evidence and record provenance before publication.

reconciliation.official_inventory_semantics: Validated calls in the official MySMIS funding registry; this is an inventory count, not an OPEN-call count.
reconciliation.coverage_gap_semantics: Authoritative inventory coverage gap only. It does not imply 921 currently OPEN or publishable opportunities.
reconciliation.material_delta_reason: The official validated-call inventory materially exceeds the current canonical MySMIS-derived call inventory, so the semantic hash change cannot be dismissed as counter-only noise.
reconciliation.next_action: Build direct call-level/paginated reconciliation from the official MySMIS registry, classify each call lifecycle independently, and publish material facts only after field-level authoritative reconciliation.
